pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions unless the initial trade has moved at least 2.5x ATR in profit and trailing stop is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a multi-timeframe liquidity sweep confirmation and an explicit 14-period ATR volatility expansion filter before order transmission.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and let the remaining runner target $25.00+ using an aggressive parabolic SAR trail.
